name: UCF101 (Video Prediction Use)
summary: 原始动作视频在后续连续视频流模型论文中被明确用于未来视频预测。
summaryEn: Original action videos are explicitly evaluated for future-video prediction in a later continuous-video-flow paper.

wmNote: 2012 是原始数据年份；2024 年预测论文补充了此前缺失的入选证据，不包含控制动作标注。
wmNoteEn: The paper explicitly evaluates future-video prediction on UCF101. This later predictive protocol supplies evidence absent from the original classification paper; no action/state-control labels are claimed.
